segments.label: THE MOMENT
segments.title:
Friday is coming.
The slides are not.
segments.body: How do you start the conversation?

segments.label: PREVIEW • RECORDED COMPARISON
segments.title:
Same moment.
Different words.
segments.text: Second Take lets you rehearse, rewind, and inspect what a different choice changes.

segments.label: 01 / FIRST ATTEMPT
segments.title:
Start with
a concern.
segments.body:
“I am worried about the project”

Alex: “What do you mean exactly?”
segments.text: I tell Alex I am worried about the project. Alex asks what I mean. The concern is expressed, but the next step is still unclear.

segments.label: 02 / REWIND
segments.title:
Go back to
the same moment.
segments.body:
Same facts. Same history.
Same conversation state.
segments.text: Now I rewind. The app restores the checkpoint before that choice, with the same facts and conversation history.

segments.label: CHECKPOINT RESTORED
segments.title:
Change one thing:
your choice.
segments.body: A second attempt from the preserved context.
segments.text: Everything before the checkpoint stays fixed. This time, I make a specific request.

segments.label: 03 / SECOND ATTEMPT
segments.title:
“Can you
finish today?”
segments.body: A capability question — or a request?
segments.text: Can you finish today? Am I asking about ability, or asking Alex to act?

segments.label: INTENT LOCK • DETAIL INSERT
segments.title:
Your intention.
Your decision.
segments.body:
Ask whether Alex can finish

or ask Alex to finish.

You confirm before the reply.
segments.text: Intent Lock asks me to confirm. My intention should be my decision, not the model's guess.

segments.label: 04 / OBSERVE THE RESPONSE
segments.title:
A partial delivery.
A clear deadline.
segments.body:
Alex: “I can finish the sources
by nine tonight.”

Sources — not the whole project.
segments.text: Alex offers the sources by nine tonight. Notice the limit: the sources, not the whole project.

segments.label: TWO ATTEMPTS • FREE
segments.title:
Practice first.
Compare next.
segments.body:
The conversation, rewind and
second attempt are free.
segments.text: Both attempts are free. The premium comparison brings the choices and immediate responses together.

segments.title:

segments.label: BUILT WITH CARE

Bounded actions.

Policy limits the available actions.
